title: What If You Spent a Year in Space? Scott Kelly Came Back Taller

scenes.text: What if you spent a whole year in space? Your height is the least of your changes.
In 2015, Scott Kelly spent 340 days on the station. His twin brother Mark stayed on Earth as a control.
Without gravity squeezing his spine, Kelly grew taller, by about two inches, then shrank back within days of landing.
His telomeres, the caps on chromosomes, got longer in orbit, then dropped fast once he came home.
About seven percent of his gene activity hadn't returned to normal six months after landing.
NASA's verdict: a year in space is survivable, but your body quietly rewrites itself.

description:
Astronaut Scott Kelly spent 340 days on the space station while his identical twin stayed on Earth.
He got taller, his telomeres changed, and gene activity shifted, some of it for months.
What should we run through next?
